chosen.premise: Kakuna looks frozen on a tree, but its shell gets hot because it is intensely preparing to evolve inside.
chosen.hook: Kakuna’s shell gets hot because it’s secretly working nonstop.
chosen.visualIdea: A motionless Kakuna clings to a tree as a thermal-camera glow builds inside its shell.
chosen.note: A highly Kakuna-specific contradiction: almost motionless outside, intensely active and visibly hot inside. The Ruby and Emerald entries directly support it.

candidates.premise: As Kakuna’s body becomes softer on the inside, its external shell hardens on the outside.
candidates.hook: Kakuna gets softer and harder at the exact same time.
candidates.visualIdea: Split-shell X-ray: the interior morphs softer while the outer casing visibly hardens like armor.
candidates.note: A concrete, visually strong transformation paradox, though it is slightly less distinctive than the hot-shell detail.

candidates.premise: Nearly unable to move, Kakuna still has one emergency move: extending a poisonous stinger at attackers.
candidates.hook: Kakuna can barely move—except when it needs to poison you.
candidates.visualIdea: Kakuna is shown nearly motionless; an approaching predator triggers a sudden stinger extension.
candidates.note: Strong contrast and excellent action potential. The entries support both Kakuna's limited movement and its poisonous barb, but the idea is less unusual than the hot shell.

candidates.premise: Kakuna exists for only three level-ups: Weedle evolves at 7, then Kakuna becomes Beedrill at 10.
candidates.hook: Kakuna’s entire stage lasts just three levels.
candidates.visualIdea: A level meter races from 7 to 10 as Weedle becomes Kakuna, then immediately bursts into Beedrill.
candidates.note: The three-level window is clear and compelling, but it depends on secondary evolution-method data and is more game-mechanic than character lore.

candidates.premise: Kakuna spends its vulnerable evolution stage hiding under leaves and branch nooks while leaning on stout trees.
candidates.hook: Kakuna’s survival strategy is to become part of the tree.
candidates.visualIdea: A camera searches a dense tree canopy before revealing Kakuna concealed beneath leaves in a branch nook.
candidates.note: The hiding behavior is supported, but 'become part of the tree' overstates the evidence and the premise is less sharply defined.

candidates.premise: Kakuna cannot run from predators, so its main defense is hardening its shell when danger arrives.
candidates.hook: When Kakuna can’t escape, it turns itself into a fortress.
candidates.visualIdea: A predator closes in as Kakuna’s shell gains layered armor textures and absorbs the threat.
candidates.note: The defensive premise is supported, but 'fortress' is a broadly applicable metaphor and the visual of absorbing attacks is not stated by the research.

rounds.request: Stronger angles would need an even sharper Kakuna-only contradiction or quantifiable reveal, while remaining directly supported by the Pokédex text and easy to visualize without adding unsupported behavior.
